raw.details:
PromptWars x Quad Bengaluru

A one-day AI vibe coding hackathon by Hack2Skill and Google for Developers, hosted by Quad AI at its HSR Layout campus in Bengaluru.

One surprise problem. Three hours. Build a working AI solution, solo.

Theme: Fraud Shield: Fighting AI-Powered Scams
Scams in India no longer look like scams. Fraudsters impersonate people and institutions you trust, using AI-generated voices and faces. Your job: build something that protects people from them. The exact problem statement is revealed at kickoff.

Important: Hack2Skill registration is mandatory
Register on Unstop, and also register here: https://hack2skill.com/event/promptwars-x-quadai
Hack2Skill is where you’ll submit your project and get scored. Without it, you can’t compete.

Join our WhatsApp Community
Get event updates, photos and news on future hackathons: https://chat.whatsapp.com/IZ7Q2bKiqmJ8hXAaZdACoe

Eligibility

  • Open to everyone: college students, freshers, working professionals and anyone curious about building with AI
  • No coding background needed
  • Individual participation only; no teams

Format

  • One round, in person, on Saturday, 5 December 2026
  • One problem statement, the same for all participants, revealed at kickoff
  • 3 hours to build a working AI solution
  • Submissions are scored by Hack2Skill’s AI evaluation on a live leaderboard
  • Top 10 on the leaderboard pitch and demo live to the jury
  • Jury picks the winners

Schedule

  • 9:30 AM: Check-in
  • 10:00 AM: Briefing
  • 11:00 AM to 2:00 PM: Build
  • 2:00 PM to 3:00 PM: Lunch break
  • 3:00 PM to 4:30 PM: Top 10 pitch to the jury
  • 4:30 PM to 5:00 PM: Winners announced

Rules

  • Solo participation only
  • No pre-built projects; everyone starts building after the problem is revealed
  • Any AI tool is allowed: Gemini, Google AI Studio, Antigravity or any tool you’re comfortable with
  • Maximum 2 submissions on Hack2Skill; your latest submission counts, not your highest
  • The jury’s decision is final

Prizes: ₹20,000 pool

  • 1st: ₹10,000
  • 2nd: ₹6,000
  • 3rd: ₹4,000

Jury

  • Nishant Das, Founder, Cheerio AI
  • Shilpa Rana, Senior Product Manager, Microsoft
  • Roshni Reddy, Head of Product, Dvara Holdings
  • Mohit Choudhary, Founder, Quad AI

What to bring

  • A fully charged laptop and charger, and a government ID.

Venue

  • Quad AI School of Technology and Business, 27th Main Road, HSR Layout, Bengaluru 560102 (beside RBIH)
    Google Maps: https://share.google/kXCXCtaNkM2fAwidt

Contact

  • partnerships@quadcse.com

Fast thinking. Sharp prompting. Real problems. Limited time.
